_comment: Calage sidecar for the Wayfinders 'meshes' jalon. Tells Rune how this iso-render PNG registers onto a Godot IsoBoard at J5. Produced by Mira 2026-05-22. Regeneratable -- do not hand-edit.

iso_projection.note: Render canvas is 2:1 (w = 2*h). The PNG is an iso view of a flat extruded slab -- the silhouette IS the land/district outline.

world_frame_m.anchor_note: SW corner of the rendered world frame, in world meters (world.yaml convention: origin SW, X east, Y north).

render_scale.note: Pixels of the RENDERED PNG per world meter. Use this to size the Sprite2D against the eT/eM camera.

godot_placement.note: eM backdrop. Wire as IsoBoard.BackgroundTexturePath; Sprite2D Centered=false, top-left at the board origin. Cities pin as POIs via city.position (world meters) -> render pixels using render_scale. Halfgate placeholder (92000,38000) is tunable until this coastline render is signed off (Varn spec section 7).
